jobs.title: Backend Engineer - Data Platform
jobs.description_text: LilEngine is leading the Lakehouse, a company-strategic effort to make Apache Iceberg a first-class citizen in Spotify's data ecosystem. We're building it in close collaboration with Google, on open standards, so that different kinds of data are queryable the same way and teams can bring the right engine, from BigQuery to Dataflow to Trino, to the job. The work has two parts. Hecate enables Iceberg for the Parquet datasets that already exist across Spotify, so teams get the benefits without rewriting their data. Alongside it, we're building the foundations of a new Lakehouse architecture that lets workflows write Iceberg tables natively. We're shipping the MVP this cycle, and you'll help shape what comes next. We also own BigQuery for all of Spotify. Thousands of engineers, data scientists and pipelines depend on it every day, which puts us on the critical path for storing, finding and querying data. We're judged on reliability, cost efficiency and how quickly we unblock users when something breaks. This backend role sits where open table formats, cloud data warehouses and processing engines meet.

jobs.description_text: To learn more visit: www.waabi.ai At the heart of our mission is an unwavering commitment to safety. Behavior Verification answers one question: is the driver's on-road behavior good enough to release, and how can we prove it even further? We are seeking a rigorous and decisive systems engineer to build the evidence behind that answer. You will define the scenario and test set content that various Software releases are measured against and that enable the development of new capabilities and features, establish the validity checks that keep those test sets trustworthy, and act as the gatekeeper for what enters the release pipeline. Your work directly informs whether autonomy software is promoted. You will… Design and document the scenario and test sets that establish on-road behavior performance, from minimum to comprehensive. Own what enters the release pipeline: define and run the scenario validity checks, and approve or refuse test sets before they are used to judge a release. Maintain continuous quality feedback of the artifacts test sets depend on — scenarios, taggers, graders and the taxonomy behind them. Turn behavior requirements into testable criteria, working with Behavior Requirements on targets and acceptance criteria that someone will sign. Investigate behavior deficiencies: find further instances, establish what exposure we have to them, and return them to the pipeline as test escapes. Business-critical functions empower these teams to execute, and together, we’re working toward one bold goal: a world with zero accidents and enhanced well-being for all. Team Our data platform team is working on accelerating autonomous driving by providing access to petabytes of data collected by our fleet of autonomous and non-autonomous vehicles. Efficient, fast and cost-effective access to data at large scale is key to tackle the hardest problems in AD/ADAS, from developing the Machine Learning (ML) models for perception and prediction of human driving patterns, to increasing the sophistication of our validation and simulation by identifying rare and interesting real-world driving situations. The data ecosystem developed by the London team is a key building block for developing and testing modern AD/ADAS products that will impact millions of customers. Our ML and Data pipelines are built on-top of the open-source Flyte orchestration framework and are deployed to AWS. Pipeline code is written in Python. We use SQS and Kafka to automate data connections and leverage BigQuery and ElasticSearch for data storage. jobs.title: Accounting Manager
jobs.description_text: Who We Are; What We Do; Where We’re Going Magnet Forensics is a global leader in the development of digital investigative software that acquires, analyzes, and shares evidence from computers, smartphones, tablets, and IoT-related devices. We are continually innovating so our customers can deploy advanced and effective tools to protect their companies, communities, and countries. Serving thousands of customers globally, our solutions are playing a crucial role in modernizing digital investigations, helping investigators fight crime, protect assets, and guard national security. With employees based around the world, Magnet Forensics has been expanding our global presence. As a part of Magnet Forensics, you can expect to make a difference in the world, no matter what role you play. You’ll be supported through learning and development, not to mention an incredible team with unbelievable talent and integrity. If you think you would be the right person to join our team working towards this goal, we would love to hear from you!

jobs.title: Accounts Payable Manager
jobs.description_text: Role Overview We are seeking an experienced Accounts Payable Manager to join our Finance team and oversee day-to-day accounts payable operations. This role is responsible for leading a team of AP professionals, ensuring payments are processed accurately and efficiently, maintaining established controls and procedures, and supporting compliance and audit requirements. This position is ideal for a hands-on leader who enjoys developing team members, improving processes, and partnering cross-functionally to support business operations while maintaining appropriate financial controls.

jobs.title: Accounts Receivable Manager
jobs.description_text: Role Overview We are seeking an experienced Accounts Receivable Manager to join our Finance team and oversee day-to-day accounts receivable operations. This role is responsible for leading the accounts receivable team, ensuring timely collections and cash application, supporting established credit and collections processes, and providing accurate reporting on receivables activity. The position is ideal for a hands-on leader who enjoys developing team members, resolving customer billing issues, and partnering cross-functionally to support efficient business operations.

jobs.title: Information Security Analyst Co-op (Winter 2027)
jobs.description_text: Role Summary Reporting to the Director, Cyber Security Operations, this co-op role operates across security operations, network engineering, and AI-driven automation. This is a hands-on role where you will work directly with real security alerts, incidents, network systems, and operational workflows. In parallel, you will help design and build automation and AI-assisted solutions that reduce manual work, improve investigation quality, and strengthen how security and network operations are executed day-to-day. Why This Role Work with real alerts, tickets, logs, and enterprise infrastructure Gain hands-on experience across both security operations and networking Build AI copilots, automations, and workflows that solve real operational problems Contribute to improving investigation quality and reducing analyst workload Help shape safe and practical enterprise use of AI

jobs.title: Manager, Customer Success
jobs.description_text: Role Overview As the Manager, Customer Success, you will be responsible for driving measurable outcomes, strengthening strategic relationships, and delivering an exceptional end-to-end customer experience for a new flagship customer. This role serves as the primary point of accountability for the customer relationship, ensuring the flagship customer receives a seamless and confident journey with Magnet. Through proactive engagement, strategic planning, and cross-functional coordination with Sales, Professional Services, Technical Support, Product Management, Engineering, and other internal teams, you’ll ensure the customer realizes sustained value from Magnet’s products and services, achieves their business objectives, and builds a long-term partnership with Magnet. In addition to leading customer success strategy and execution, you’ll directly lead a team of two Technical Support Engineers, ensuring strong technical engagement, timely issue resolution, proactive risk identification, and a seamless connection between technical support and the broader customer success strategy. This role reports to the Director, Customer Success.

jobs.title: Platform Sales Consultant (Bilingual Spanish or Italian)
jobs.description_text: Role Overview Magnet Forensics is looking for a highly motivated, results-driven Platform Consultant to play a critical role in driving Sales success for Magnet’s platform products. The successful candidate will play a key role as an internal advisor to our Sales teams and will be an integral resource in navigating large, complex sales opportunities. They will also assist in proactive market engagement and business development activities to identify and increase demand for our platform products leading to increased solution sales success. A second European language especially Spanish would be a distinct advantage.

jobs.title: Sales Development Representative
jobs.description_text: Role Overview At Magnet Forensics Inc, the Sales Development Reps are the frontlines of the Customer experience. Working closely with the Sales and Marketing teams, the Sales Development Representative (SDR) is a key player in our strategic growth plans. Through a combination of top of funnel activities, including both inbound lead response and outbound prospecting, the SDR will generate and qualify sales opportunities for our Account Executives. The most exciting part of this role is the opportunity for growth. At Magnet Forensics, successful SDRs will learn the fundamentals of Sales and Marketing providing a foundation for a career in Business Development, Sales, Marketing and more! Who Should Apply: As a successful candidate for this role, you are passionate about developing new skills and building a network of peers & mentors. You are motivated by healthy competition and you’re eager to be the leader of a winning group or team. You display resiliency when faced with adversity, and ultimately, you are naturally curious, consistently looking for novel ways to solve problems and improve processes.

jobs.title: Sales Operations Analyst
jobs.description_text: Role Overview The Magnet Forensics Order Operations team plays a critical role at Magnet, ensuring our customers receive their products in a timely and accurate manner. This team is a highly motivated, detail-oriented group who focus on continual improvement and upping their game to delight our customers and internal stakeholders. The Sales Operations Analyst is responsible for the end of sale cycle within the organization. In this role, you will maintain salesforce contract data, fulfil licenses, invoice customers, ship products to external Customers and work with the internal teams to meet Customer needs and ensure contractual compliance.

jobs.title: Senior Technical Support Engineer
jobs.description_text: Role Overview The Senior Technical Support Engineer is a technical escalation point for complex, high-impact, and sensitive customer issues. This role leads systemic problem management, develops technical capability across the Support team, and partners with Engineering and Product Management to reduce recurring issues, improve product quality, and strengthen support effectiveness. This is a senior individual contributor role with technical leadership responsibilities and no direct reports. This position reports directly to the Manager, Customer Success and receives functional direction from the Director, Technical Support.

jobs.title: Staff Software Engineer
jobs.description_text: Role OverviewWe’re looking for a seasoned Staff Software Engineer who thrives on technical depth and broad influence. You’re as comfortable designing architecture as you are shipping code, and you care deeply about developer experience, scalability, and performance. You’ve likely led modernization efforts, built shared frameworks or design systems, and enjoy helping others adopt better patterns at scale. As a Staff Software Engineer on the Artifacts Knowledge Team, you’ll play a pivotal role in defining our cloud-native data enrichment service, ensuring it meets the demands of performance, reliability, and future growth. You’ll collaborate closely with Senior Engineers, Technical Leads, and Product Managers to architect robust solutions, drive informed design decisions, and champion best practices. Beyond technical leadership, you’ll actively mentor and empower the team—multiplying their skills and fostering a culture of continuous improvement and innovation. This is a hands-on technical leadership role: Part Architect, Part Builder, and Part Mentor. You’ll lead by example, designing a scalable data enrichment service, and guiding engineering teams toward better patterns, tooling, and practices. NOTE: Candidates must reside in Canada.

jobs.title: Enterprise Account Executive
jobs.description_text: About the role: Anyscale is growing its Sales Team! We're looking for a Bay Area based Enterprise Account Executive to build out our enterprise-level client relationships. The Enterprise AE’s must have the confidence and ability to negotiate and close agreements with clients and support new customers. Anyscale is an innovative, high-growth, customer-focused company in a large and growing market. jobs.description_text: About the role: As a Forward Deployed Engineer - AI/ML Platforms at Anyscale, you’ll partner with some of the world’s most sophisticated AI organizations to design, deploy, and operate the infrastructure powering their production AI workloads. jobs.title: Compliance Manager
jobs.description_text: ABOUT THE ROLE Anyscale's security and compliance needs are growing as we work with larger and more demanding customers. Compliance is increasingly a customer-facing, contractual function rather than an internal exercise, and we are looking for someone to own it. You will work directly with the Head of Security and across engineering, IT, legal, and sales. This is a program-ownership role with the autonomy and accountability that implies. You will not have a senior compliance function above you to defer to; you are that function. Ray Data has a large and active community, so you'll also work closely with external contributors to review designs, guide technical direction, and support the project's continued growth and success. You'll work on two things: Internal AI initiatives – helping unlock AI tooling and integrations across Xsolla faster than our existing teams can alone. Proof-of-concept builds on our own APIs – showing our product and engineering teams what's possible when you build with AI as a core part of your workflow, not an afterthought. This isn't a shadow-and-observe internship. You'll ship code that goes to customers – internal teams or external players and game developers – working closely with senior engineers and fellow interns across our global regions. Who You'll Work With You won't be isolated on an intern-only project island. You'll work closely with senior engineers who are actively rebuilding how we write software, and you'll be part of a global cohort of interns building in parallel across our regions. You will own quality for Xsolla's smart wallet on Xsolla ZK, our Ethereum-compatible ZK rollup: the wallet players use to hold, receive and send tokens and in-game items, signing in with the account they already have. The work runs on both sides of the chain. On the backend, you will confirm that a wallet address pre-computed from a salt is the address that actually gets deployed. On the frontend, you will follow a signed operation from the client's RPC call through the bundler to finality, and prove it landed, failed or reverted the way it should. You will fork the chain to test against real state, deploy and call contracts from the command line, and turn what you learn into automated suites. You will work in a small, senior engineering team alongside an external wallet-infrastructure partner. You can tell a defect in our code from one in a partner SDK or in the chain itself — and you bring the evidence to show which. AI coding tools are part of how you work every day, and you set them up so the rest of the team gets the same leverage.

About the Role We're looking for a Staff Engineer to own the smart wallet and account abstraction layer of Xsolla's Web3 platform. This is an individual contributor role with outsized technical scope: you'll be the technical anchor for how millions of players get an on-chain account they never have to think about — setting direction, making hard architectural calls, and raising the bar across the org. Concretely, you'll own the account model behind Xsolla ZK, our zkSync-based L2, and the wallet that sits inside Xsolla App. Every player who signs in with Xsolla ID receives a deterministic, non-custodial smart account — derived from their identity claim, identical on every device, with private keys that never leave the client. That account is not a separate "wallet" screen: it is the player's inventory, and it backs minting, gifting, trading on our Bazaar marketplace, Merkle-based reward airdrops, gas sponsorship, and an in-app dApp browser that exposes the same signer to third-party applications through an EIP-1193 provider. You'll own the primitives underneath all of it: the ERC-4337 user operation lifecycle, EIP-7702 delegation, session keys and origin-bound Smart Sessions, paymaster and gas abstraction strategy, and the custody and recovery roadmap — including the move from raw key export to MPC custody. jobs.description_text: Als projectleider gebiedsontwikkeling bij Waalpartners speel je een cruciale rol in het realiseren van de nieuwbouwopgaven van onze opdrachtgevers. Jij bewaart het overzicht, staat naast de opdrachtgever en draagt bij aan oplossingen voor de uitdagingen die woningbouw met zich meebrengt. Zo hebben we recentelijk meegedacht voor de nieuwe woonomgeving ‘Vlijweide’ in Dordrecht. Bij deze locatie ontwikkeling komt nogal wat bij elkaar. Water, bodem, ecologie, een primaire waterkering én verschillende partijen met ieder hun eigen verantwoordelijkheid en expertise. En dat alles om een toekomstbestendig nieuw woongebied te ontwikkelen. Dit ga je doen Met je brede kennis en jarenlange ervaring sta je stevig in een dynamische projectomgeving. Zowel in de voorbereidende als de uitvoerende fase zorg je ervoor dat het proces vloeiend blijft verlopen, ook bij langdurige integrale projecten. Je eigen netwerk zet je in om de dienstverlening van Waalpartners verder te profileren. Als projectleider ben je bovendien de spil in de ontwikkeling van zowel medewerkers als de organisatie. Dat doe je niet alleen: samen schop je ‘t verder. Je werkt nauw samen met het management en de overige projectleiders over offertes, de bureauplanning en kansen in de markt. Dit ben jij Je bent open, nieuwsgierig en staat als leidinggevende stevig in je schoenen.
